finding.cause: The tryfirst pytest_collection_finish wrapper validated before yielding, so an ordinary trylast finish hook could register pytest_runtestloop afterward. Collection-wide checks also could not see pytest_pyfunc_call executors registered during an item's setup hook or autouse fixture.
finding.control: The outer collection-finish wrapper now validates after yield, when all ordinary implementations and wrapper teardowns have completed. A tryfirst pytest_runtest_call wrapper validates before yielding for every item, after its setup and immediately before call implementations can replace its body. Both boundaries reuse the existing owner policy.
finding.classification: Collection-finish refusal is authenticated incomplete/ptest with observed runner exit 4. Setup-time and fixture-time refusal is authenticated incomplete/ptest with observed runner exit 1; the latter remains diagnostic Pytest evidence, not a certified native test failure.
finding.reason_text: The public unsupported-capability reason now says the bridge refused test execution rather than incorrectly claiming every refusal occurred before collection.

This target repository is executable local code, not a sandbox. Conftest import, collection hooks, test-module import, setup hooks and fixtures can perform side effects before a refusal. The control prevents ordinary unowned executors from certifying a false pass; it does not claim hostile code cannot catch or reforge internal exceptions or reports.
Known execution-control plugin names and unqualified critical wrappers remain fail-closed, including active pytest-cov; compatibility was not broadened.
Full, automatic, setup orchestration, shadow, probe, source identity, native selection/inventory, history, baseline, worker parallelism, API and TUI remain outside this repair.

Direct ptest in the fresh task worktree resolves older development tooling that includes pytest-xdist and refuses this checkout. All evidence therefore used the required frozen controller bootstrap with explicit task PYTHONPATH; installer and product configuration were not changed.
